name: devai
description: DEVAI 1.5 developer-acceleration CLI for focused automation and trustworthy evidence.
author: Antonio Augusto Russo <aarusso@nyxk.com.br>

scripts.devai:prepare: node scripts/check-mutation-free-delivery.mjs && node scripts/check-policy-materialization.mjs && node scripts/check-test-task-workspace-selectors.mjs && node scripts/generate-error-code-reference.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-scorecard-page.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-action-registry.mjs
scripts.authority:materialize: node packages/cli/dist/runtime/index/bin.js init bind --target . --as-role architect --write --format json
scripts.test:authority: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/authority/tests
scripts.test:cli: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/cli/tests
scripts.test:effects: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/effects-check/tests
scripts.test:evidence: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/evidence/tests
scripts.test:loop: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/loop/tests
scripts.test:sensors: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/sensors/tests
scripts.test:schemas: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/schemas/tests
scripts.test:skills: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/skills/tests
scripts.test:spec: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/spec/tests
scripts.test:utils: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts packages/utils/tests
scripts.test:root: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/local.config.ts tests/contract tests/integration
scripts.test:perf: node scripts/process/validation-runner.mjs -- vitest run --config tests/config/rc.performance.config.ts tests/regression
